name: Nariyuki Yuiga
source:
Nariyuki is a third-year student who was appointed as a tutor for Fumino Furuhashi, Rizu Ogata and Uruka Takemoto as a condition to get the VIP nomination for getting into a college.

He is a hardworking student even if he was not good at studying in the past; following his father's encouragement to become someone who can do everything. It was through hard work and diligence, he was able to achieve a steady grade of 80% on all subjects.

Nariyuki is a caring person with the goal of getting a scholarship so he can give his poor family a better life. Not only that, but he is also caring for his friends whenever they're in any trouble, always helping them out without a single complaint.

[Edited from [url=https://weneverlearn.fandom.com/wiki/Nariyuki_Yuiga]We Never Learn Wiki[/url]]
